newsitem.title: UNITED ARAB EMIRATES: SOCCER-SYRIA BEAT UZBEKISTAN TO HAND CHINA QUARTER-FINAL TICKET.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SYRIA BEAT UZBEKISTAN TO HAND CHINA QUARTER-FINAL TICKET.

text.p: Syria upset Uzbekistan 2-1 in an Asian Cup group C match on Thursday to hand China the tournament's last quarter-final ticket.

China, Syria and Uzbekistan ended the group matches with three points each but China's better goal difference put them in second place behind holders Japan, who won all three of their preliminary round games.
Uzbekistan needed only a draw to advance to the next stage after beating China 2-0 in their opening game.
Japan scored a last-minute goal to beat China 1-0 earlier on Thursday.
To add to their misery, Uzbekistan had goalscorer Lebedev Sergey sent off two minutes after conceding their second goal for an off-the-ball tackle on defender Yasser Sibai.
The Syrians, who had to win by four goals to go through to the next stage of the 12-nation competition, started the match brightly but failed to make the most of their chances.
Three minutes into the second half Nader Jokhadar put Syria in front when he rose above his marker to head home a cross by Sibai.
Lebedev Sergey equalised from the penalty spot in the 53rd minute after he was brought down by Hatem Ghaeb.
Ali Dib restored Syria's lead in the 72nd minute when he blasted in a loose ball from inside the box after a goalmouth scramble.
